rationale: The FIFO has one synchronous clock and its clear, write-side, and read-side interface ports all have explicit delays referenced to that clock.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the synchronous FIFO to two eight-bit entries with registered pointers and full/empty state.

mutation.description: The compact two-entry pointer encoding changes implementation detail only; both handshakes remain synchronous to fifo_clk.
